blocks.orig: Kahawa House lies in Arusha at a short distance from the city centre, the domestic airport and Arusha National Park, and as such it’s ideally located to start your safari or to spend your last evening before heading back home or on to Zanzibar. The 30 lovely, spacious rooms are situated in a lovingly designed two-storey building and offer comfy beds and a bathtub in the ensuite bathroom. A swimming pool, a good restaurant and free WiFi are the finishing touches to ensure a good night’s rest.
blocks.html: You will find Kahawa House in Arusha, a short way from the city centre, the domestic airport and Arusha National Park, so it’s well placed as a starting point for your safari or for your final night before you fly home or continue to Zanzibar. Its 30 pleasant, roomy rooms are in a carefully designed two-storey building, with comfortable beds and a bathtub in the ensuite bathroom. A swimming pool, a good restaurant and free WiFi complete the picture, so you can count on a good night’s sleep.
